reply: Money stress is real and there is help on campus for it. One Stop Student Services Center (Financial Aid and Student Accounting) is the place for this, about 0.08 km from you; 856-225-6039. This week there is also Scarlet Raptor's Nest food pantry in-person shopping at Camden Tower Offices, Room 124. Off campus: help with money and bills near you at https://uhnj.findhelp.com/money/all?postal=08102. Want me to narrow it down, or just keep talking?
